column3: Locate and fixture the structured Codex/provider usage event; define the normalized turn schema and explicit NULL/source states for Total/Input/Cached/Output/Reasoning. Preserve the observation-only policy: no control-plane reads or gates. Artifact docs/token-usage-source-schema-20260908.md.

Implement an idempotent append-only recorder keyed by engine+thread_id+turn_id with privacy-whitelisted raw/normalized JSONL, locking, permissions, replay, and duplicate/conflict tests. Collection must never block completion callbacks or agent work. Artifact docs/token-usage-recorder-20260908.md.

Implement provider-total versus input+output reconciliation, cached/reasoning non-additive checks, idempotent replay, explicit missing/mismatch states, and fixtures. Verdicts are informational and cannot fail or gate unrelated work. Artifact docs/token-usage-reconciliation-20260908.md.

Add read-only reporting by turn/session/window/model with coverage and missing-field counts. Do not add budgets, thresholds, alerts, routing, scoring, or enforcement. Artifact docs/token-usage-reporting-20260908.md.

Run a live bounded canary and replay audit; verify field provenance, dedupe, reconciliation, privacy, deployed/source wiring, and prove token values have no control-plane consumer. Artifact docs/token-usage-live-canary-20260908.md.
